messages:
Alma: Uploaded the final manifest for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need quick QA on routing, AMI/image refs, and the trial blurb.
Theo: On it. Do we have definitive AMI/VM refs or placeholders?
Jun: AWS AMI ready: ami-0aa11bb22. GCP image path: projects/redwood-prod/global/images/rw-release-2026-03. Azure image pending.
Alma: Note: If Azure is missing, we should submit AWS+GCP first and mark Azure as "coming soon" in notes. Partnership approvals ok with staggered release?
Priya: UX: trial blurb must match billing portal exactly: "14-day free trial, no card required". Keep alt text under 80 chars.
Theo: SKU naming from finance: RW-<cloud>-<tier>-<region>. I'll add meter_id stubs and ping finance for final IDs.
LegalBot: Legal check: do NOT claim EU-only hosting until infra confirms region isolation. Need localized EULA snippet for FR/DE.
Alma: Marking EU residency: false in manifest until infra confirms. Adding action: infra verify region isolation.
Jun: Infra ETA for Azure image: tomorrow 11:00 PT. If not ready, we'll proceed with AWS/GCP.
Priya: I'll prepare three cropped tiles (16:9, 4:3, 1:1) and alt texts. Uploading to /shared/marketplace/assets.
Theo: I'll add telemetry endpoint mapping per SKU to avoid cross-region calls. Example: rw-telemetry.eu -> telemetry.eu.redwood.ai
Alma: Action items recap: Jun get Azure image or confirm staging; Theo finalize SKUs + meter_ids; Priya finalize images + copy; LegalBot provide EULA snippets. Target internal sign-off tomorrow 16:00 PT.
Jun: Will update here when Azure image is uploaded.
Priya: Copy pass done by 13:00 PT.
Theo: Pinged finance for final meter ids.
LegalBot: Draft EULA localizations uploaded to `legal/eu-eula-snippets.docx`.
Alma: Thanks. If blockers, flag here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
